body: From the DM-186 review (orchestrator, this run): corrective work created by `create_corrections` adds a Fireguard ticket by default (owner-plan decision for corrective sprints), which contradicts skills/planner.md:67 ('Never add one by default') — update the planner skill to state the corrective-work exception. Document the new MCP tools preview_corrections, create_corrections, get_retro_findings, get_experiment, record_experiment_event in the skills and docs/runbooks/mcp-setup.md (whose tool table was already out of date). Document experiment restatement on resubmission (by id + {reportId, assessmentId}) for orchestrators.
